_doctrine: PRINCIPAL ARTIFACTS: one canonical scene + one harmonized interface; instances are registry configs (the motif/cartridge move made explicit). The principal declares the DISPLAY footprint once — pose, cells, height — and every instance inherits it via tools/principal_artifacts.py --sync-footprints (source:principal in artifact_sizes.json). Per-instance AABB measurement is wrong for these: it catches planes lying flat (grid2d h=0.02) or nothing (grid3d, composition unmeasured). The type is the spatial truth; edit it HERE. interface[] = the harmonized config contract — the migration target for instances that drift. KIN families (kin{}) are interface-similar artifacts with SEPARATE scenes/scripts — harmonization candidates the gallery surfaces via declared members, name stems (pattern_machine_a..d), and suffix conventions (*_workbench, *_machine). INTEGRATION (Palle 2026-07-09): the wrapper is the middle layer — what makes an artifact FEEL integrated in map space. Vocabulary: self (brings its own base — no bed, no wrapper: workbenches, kiosks), cube (the 1m sim-housing — the grid cell made visible; wrapper IS the bed AND carries the harmonized physical interface: label plate, play/pause, cartridge slot), frame (flat work, framed + wall/hover mounted), plinth (small, held to the eye), field (the artifact IS the environment — room-scale, housing would kill it). Declared integration PRECEDES size-guessed beds; 'field'/apparition stays unhoused on purpose (the sieve's dark spot).

wrappers._note: Palle: 'room for more cube families so we do not collapse all objects — the DNA makes the different cube families look different.' The cube is a GENUS: the chassis is invariant (the shared hand-grammar), the family is expression (legible at 3m). Families assigned at PRINCIPAL level = wayfinding: you read the department by its vitrine. Keep the family count small (5-8). Build target: CubeWrapperLibrary (Godot builders -> glTF, the WallVariantLibrary pipeline).
